Bildformat 2:3, 1024x1536. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Image 2 Ceffyl profile is BREED ANATOMY ONLY: elegant long arched neck, finer expressive face, proud carriage and flowing movement. Ignore the people, armor and watercolor styles in those two. Image 3 Cador sets only our established clean-lined ANIME horse portrait art direction and modest Draig saddlecloth treatment. Do not copy Cador's beige coat, hairstyle or exact pose. Image 4 actual HOUSE DRAIG EMBLEM supplies the small red dragon over a black castle on ivory, not the ornate emblem border.
Horse: a robust but noticeably noble cavalry mount, muscular Rhyfel shoulders and deep chest with the longer elegant Ceffyl neck, strong well-proportioned legs and modest fetlock hair. Deep glossy MAHOGANY BAY coat, dark lower legs, long black mane brushed into a natural tidy sweep on one side, black tail. Small irregular ivory star on forehead, warm amber-brown eyes. Composed, quietly authoritative personality suitable for the adjutant to the field marshal: raised head, steady direct alert gaze, one ear attending to the viewer, the other listening back. Natural dignified expression, no teeth or exaggerated anger.
Conservative functional brown leather saddle and bridle, simple dark-red compact saddlecloth with ONE small authentic Draig emblem patch on visible side, restrained brass buckles. No horse armor, no layers of straps, no bags, weapons, dangling trophies or large flags. No people.
Quiet sunlit cavalry courtyard beside a low pale-stone parapet at Celtigerns Wacht, a little short grass and a softly simplified distant tower. Horse fully visible and dominant, three-quarter body angled toward the RIGHT, head slightly turned toward viewer, relaxed square standing pose, all four hooves and both ears inside frame. Natural balanced anatomy. No collage, text, lettering, watermark or decorative frame.

CRITICAL COAT CORRECTION: the BASE at the TOP is BEIGE. Head, upper neck, back and upper flanks should be clearly pale neutral sandy BEIGE / champagne, not orange and not uniformly yellow. Moving VERTICALLY DOWNWARDS, the coat gradually becomes increasingly GOLDEN: lower neck and lower chest warm champagne gold, belly and lower flanks richer honey-gold, lower legs clearly luminous rich golden-yellow. All FOUR HOOFS themselves have a clear GOLDEN natural horn color. They must not be gray, black, brown, or covered by golden armor. Make the downward beige-to-gold gradient visibly clear, harmonious, not a harsh stripe. No glow or glitter.
CRITICAL MANE CORRECTION: a VERY DENSE, VERY VOLUMINOUS WHITE MANE, much fuller and more luxuriant than the previous image. Large sweeping white waves and layered thick locks cascading down the neck; predominantly clean ivory WHITE from roots through most of each lock, with distinct PALE LIGHT-GOLD TIPS on the ends. Do NOT leave the mane mostly yellow, honey-colored, brown, flat or thin. Full rich white forelock with pale gold tips. Match the abundant tail to the white hair with pale gold ends.
MORE ATTITUDE: she is a pampered, proud, capricious diva, though an excellent riding horse. Raise her chin distinctly, arch her neck proudly, angle her head to deliver an unimpressed sideways glance with slightly narrowed intelligent eyes, one ear forward and one cocked slightly back. Convey confident haughtiness and impatience through HORSE anatomy, not a human face. Closed mouth, no teeth, no rearing. The calm standing body and one relaxed hind hoof can remain. The horse should look like she expects others to wait for her.
Keep simple restrained equipment and existing composition, no extra straps, objects, ornate jewelry, crown, horns, wings, people, captions, watermark or collage. Clear clean anime lineart and cel-shading, horse dominant, all ears and four golden hooves in frame.

Create ONE finished full-body horse portrait for Carys Draig, with no rider. A clearly recognizable TIRASHAN woodland riding horse, an established breed combining Curragh woodland agility and Hest robustness. It is a medium-sized, compact muscular mount, with a short strong back, broad useful chest, well-set neck of moderate length, sturdy joints and dependable hooves. Agile and practical with visible substance, neither a delicate elf horse nor a giant draft horse.

Distinctive individual appearance: an earthy mouse-brown / smoky grey-dun coat with a warmer brown muzzle, subtle dark dorsal stripe visible where the saddle does not cover it, dark charcoal lower legs, dark hooves, and an ample black-brown mane and tail. A small irregular pale snip near the nose adds individuality. The mane is practical, slightly tousled, with just one simple braid. A calm and attentive woodland companion, intelligent eyes, one ear listening into the woods and one turned to the viewer. Relaxed standing three-quarter pose with head gently turned toward us; mouth closed, no charging or rearing.

Conservative riding equipment: a plain brown leather saddle, a coherent simple bridle with naturally hanging reins, two sensible stirrups, a restrained dark red saddlecloth with one small ivory patch showing HOUSE DRAIG'S actual emblem: a red dragon in front of a black castle. Keep heraldry simple and small. No armor, excess straps, bags, ornaments, weapons, people, deer, antlers or other animals.

Quiet early autumn woodland edge beside a low pale stone boundary wall. Soft green foliage and a narrow earth path, blue daylight filtering through an opening. The horse takes about 80% of the vertical frame. BOTH ears, full flowing tail, and ALL FOUR HOOVES are inside frame with breathing room. Clean readable silhouette, anatomically coherent equine limbs.

3. House Draig emblem defines heraldic motif ONLY, do not copy its surrounding decorative frame.
